text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is reporting on the results of the traffic calming poll undertaken on Overbrook Place, between Dufferin Street and Wilmington Avenue. The poll provided a response rate of less than the 50 percent plus one ballot required by the traffic calming policy in order to confirm that there is a favourable consensus in the community to install speed humps on the subject section of Overbrook Place. Accordingly, continuing the process to install speed humps on Overbrook Place, between Dufferin Street and Wilmington Avenue, is not recommended.

North York Community Council: 1. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install eight speed humps on Overbrook Place, between Dufferin Street and Wilmington Avenue, generally as shown on Drawing No. NYDD18-0002 dated March 2018, attached to the report (May 10, 2018) entitled "Speed Hump Poll Results - Overbrook Place" from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, North York District.
